claim_boundary: Applicability freeze only; no parent baseline has been executed or reproduced, and a style-labelled approximation must not be reported as a faithful parent reproduction.
object: Fair matched parent controls for Paper 3 training-data selection and inference-time workflow transfer.

full_fidelity_requirements: Freeze skill definitions and evaluation skills before outcome access.
Learn or reproduce the data-driven skill dependency relation from the parent-observable training signal rather than substituting curator structural labels.
Run the adaptive sequential sampler with matched base model, tokenizer, corpus candidates, total token budget, evaluation schedule and random-seed policy.
Report the parent objective and all per-round sampling decisions and checkpoints as receipts.
non_applicable_claims: Skill-It is not an inference-time workflow-transfer baseline.
A fixed dependency-Jaccard feature is not a faithful reproduction of adaptive Skill-It sampling.
parents.parent_projection: Data-driven skill dependency learning and adaptive sequential data sampling for language-model training.
parents.source: Chen et al., Skill-It! A Data-Driven Skills Framework for Understanding and Training Language Models, NeurIPS 2023.

full_fidelity_requirements: Use a mathematical pretraining corpus and parent-compatible skill labels and skill graph, or document a preregistered domain adaptation as a partial diagnostic rather than a reproduction.
Match base model, tokenizer, candidate data, token budget, optimization budget and mathematical downstream evaluations across arms.
Implement the graph-guided selection rule rather than replacing it with static tag overlap.
Account for graph construction and data-scoring cost in total cost-to-capability.
non_applicable_claims: MASS is not an inference-time retrieval or workflow-transfer baseline.
Performance outside mathematical pretraining is an adaptation test, not direct reproduction of the published scope.
parents.parent_projection: Mathematical pretraining-data selection through a mathematical skill graph.
parents.source: Li et al., MASS: Mathematical Data Selection via Skill Graphs for Pretraining Large Language Models, ICML 2025.

full_fidelity_requirements: Use tasks admitting an explicit operator library and executable workflow graph; otherwise mark SWIFT not applicable.
Match base model, operator library, source workflows, workflow-search budget, task interface, execution budget and success verifier.
Reproduce structural-prior extraction and transfer, including the parent refusal or negative-transfer behavior where available.
Charge source-workflow search and structural-prior construction before reporting marginal or break-even savings.
non_applicable_claims: SWIFT is not a training-data-selection baseline.
A graph-similarity scalar without executable workflow transfer is not a faithful SWIFT reproduction.
Scientific source-target pairs without a shared executable operator interface fall outside direct SWIFT applicability.
parents.parent_projection: Amortized transfer of structural workflow priors across agent tasks.
parents.source: Du et al., Why Search When You Can Transfer? Amortized Agentic Workflow Design from Structural Priors, arXiv:2604.25012, 2026.

qoi: Which parent is a valid control for which phase, and what must be reproduced before its name can carry comparative authority?
